common.rights: Under the GDPR you can ask us what we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, object to how we use it, and withdraw consent at any time. Write to us at {contact}. You can also complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten, IMY).

privacy.lead: How Telning Publishing House handles your data on this website, on the email list, and in the emails you send us. Plain words, no cookies, no trackers.

p: Telning Publishing House is a brand of WelloWork AB, a company in Sweden ({orgNumber}). Our address: {address}.
If you have a question about your data, write to {contact}.

This notice covers the website telning.com, the shop (books, posters and gifts), the email list, the quote form for organisations, and emails you send us. The story-card form ("Send Pim your ending") has its own notice, written for parents: the children's privacy notice.
We use no cookies, no analytics scripts, no advertising and no tracking pixels. We do not build profiles of visitors.

Our host, Vercel, delivers the pages. To do that it processes your IP address and may keep short-lived technical logs for security. We do not use those logs to identify you. See Vercel's own privacy notice for details.

The shop keeps your basket and your currency choice in your browser’s local storage, on your device. They are not sent to us until you go to checkout. This is not a cookie and it does not track you; you can clear it in your browser at any time.
When you sign up for "Letters from Pim", the TADA guide or the teacher pack, we keep your email address and which list you chose.

We use this only to send you what you asked for: a note when a new book is out, the guide, or the pack. The legal basis is your consent. Every email has a way to unsubscribe; after that we send you nothing more, and you can ask us to delete your address completely.
{emailService} keeps the list and sends the emails for us. It processes your address on our behalf.
When you write to us at our contact address, we use your email address and your message only to reply. We never add you to the email list because you wrote to us.
We keep the conversation as long as it is open, then delete it.

When you buy, we need your name, email address, delivery address, phone number (the delivery partners need it) and what you ordered. We use them to make and deliver your order, to send you the order emails, to handle returns, and to keep the records that Swedish accounting law asks for.
Payment is handled by Stripe. You enter your card or other payment details on Stripe’s page; we never see or store your card number. Stripe tells us that the payment went through.

Your order goes to our trusted printing and delivery partners, the companies that make and deliver books, Story Walls and gifts for us. They receive your name, delivery address, phone number and the items, only to make and deliver them. Order emails are sent with Resend.

Some of these companies are outside the EU or use servers outside the EU. They do so under the safeguards the GDPR requires, such as the EU standard contractual clauses. The legal basis is the contract with you, and our legal duty to keep accounts.

When you send the form on For organisations, we receive your organisation, country, number of children, your message and your email address by email. We use them only to answer your request and, if you order, to make the offer and the invoice.
{rights}

This website is for grown-ups. We do not knowingly collect data from children. The story-card form asks a parent for a child's first name, age and drawing, with the parent's consent, and never for a photo of a child. How we handle that is in the children's privacy notice.
When we change this notice, we change the date at the top of this page.

childrens.lead: For parents who send a drawing for a story card: what we collect, why, how long we keep it, who processes it, and your rights.

sections.h: Who we are and who this is for
p: Telning Publishing House is a brand of WelloWork AB, a company in Sweden ({orgNumber}). This notice is for the parent or guardian who uses the form at telning.com/send. The form is for grown-ups over 18; a child never uses it alone.
The shop on telning.com is for adults: children do not order there.

list: your email address, to send the story card
your child's first name and age, to write on the card
a photo of the drawing page (we ask for no people in the photo; if a photo shows a person, we do not use it and ask you for a new one)
which book the drawing comes from
your optional answers about the talk you had (feelings in the story, why your child chose the ending, real life)
your consents, and the time of sending
your IP address, used only for a few minutes to stop spam, not stored with your form

p: We use the name, age and drawing to make the story card, and your answers to write ideas for your next talk. Nothing else.

The legal basis is your consent, which you give on the form. Your answers can say something about your child's feelings, which the law protects specially, so we ask for explicit consent for them and never use them for anything else. We never use anything you send to test, judge or diagnose your child.
Your form goes in one email to our small team. A person makes the card and writes your tips. We delete that email after we reply, and within {keepDays} days in every case.
Your answers are not saved in any database, file, log or statistics. They are read once, for your tips, and are gone.

The drawing is deleted right after we send your card. If you ticked the box that lets us share the card on Instagram or TikTok, we keep only the finished story card image (first name, age and drawing), never your answers or your email. You can ask us to take it down at any time.

list: our website host, {host}, which receives the form, removes the photo's hidden data (camera, date, place) and sends it on
{emailService}, which carries the email to our team and the card to you
{aiLine}
ask for or keep a photo of a child
judge, test or diagnose a child, or give advice about a child's health
share your answers or your email with anyone
add you to the email list unless you ask for that separately
use cookies, trackers or advertising

p: {rights}
If you withdraw your consent after we shared a card, we delete the card from our social media.
Write to {contact}. We answer every email.

terms.lead: The terms for using telning.com and the Telning story-card service. Short sections, plain English.

p: telning.com is run by WelloWork AB, a company in Sweden ({orgNumber}), address {address}. Telning Publishing House is a brand of WelloWork AB. In these terms "we" means WelloWork AB.

The texts, pictures, Pim, the TADA name and the books on this site belong to us or to the people who made them. You may read the site and share links to it. You may not copy the pages of a Telning book or the site's art for other uses without our written permission.
The site is information, not advice. Nothing on it is medical, psychological or educational advice about your child.

list: The form is for a parent or guardian over 18.

You own your child's drawing. By sending it you let us use the first name, age and drawing to make one story card and send it to you. If you tick the sharing box, you also let us show that card on Telning's Instagram and TikTok; you can withdraw this at any time.
We do not accept photos that show a person. We may refuse a submission that breaks these terms.
We aim to reply within the time shown on the form. This is a service we offer with care, not a promise of a reply at a fixed time.
The ideas in the talk-next note are general ideas, not advice about your child's health or development.

p: You can unsubscribe at any time with the link in every email. We write only when there is something to tell: a new book, the guide or the pack you asked for.

list: The seller is WelloWork AB, Sweden ({orgNumber}), trading as Telning Publishing House.
Prices in euros and pounds include VAT. Prices in US and Canadian dollars do not include sales tax; where it applies, it is added at checkout. Shipping is shown in the basket before you pay.
Your order is accepted when the payment goes through and we send the order confirmation by email.
Everything is made for you after you order. Our trusted printing and delivery partners make and deliver on our behalf, as close to you as they can. Delivery times are on Shipping & returns.
You can cancel within 14 days of delivery and return unused items, as described on Shipping & returns. Damaged, faulty or wrong items are replaced or refunded at our cost.
Many product photos on the site are pictures made from our print files, not photographs. Printed colours can differ a little from your screen.
Organisations can pay by invoice: the details are agreed by email with the offer.

p: We work with care, but we cannot promise that the site is always available or free of mistakes. As far as Swedish law allows, we are not liable for loss that comes from using the site. Your rights as a consumer are not changed by these terms.
Swedish law applies to these terms. If we change them, we change the date at the top of this page. Questions: {contact}.
